deepdive.sec: B2B Gold Jewellery Manufacturing with Integrated D2C Silver Retail

bull_bear.body: IPO proceeds funding capex (CNC, Sharjah, Esthara retail); debt reduction priority; no dividend history disclosed; reinvestment in design R&D and manufacturing scale
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Geopolitical delays in Sharjah acquisition; reliance on few large corporate clients (Kalyan, Chemmanur); silver retail execution risk in D2C; raw material price volatility; regulatory changes in hallmarking/GST compliance
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Esthara’s 50% D2C silver margin is unusually high for jewellery retail — enabled by vertical integration (manufacturing + direct sales), bypassing wholesale markups entirely, creating a hidden profit engine.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: B2B Gold: 22K/18K casting & studded jewellery via digital portal; 2.5L+ designs; low MOQ; 15-day production cycle. D2C Silver (Esthara): 925 Sterling + 2.5-micron gold-plated; 50% gross margin; sold via owned stores & e-commerce; 5 stores under fit-out in Kerala for H1 FY27
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: B2B EBITDA margin: 4.81% (FY26); PAT margin: 2.69% (FY26); Esthara silver D2C margin: ~50%; cost reduction via CNC & automation; bullion sourcing efficiency via Sharjah
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Targeting 50% CAGR over 3 years; FY27 standalone revenue guidance of ~₹450 Cr; Sharjah acquisition expected to add ~₹60 Cr by end FY27; 120% capacity expansion planned; Esthara silver retail to scale to 5+ stores in H1 FY27
outlook.title: Guidance / outlook

outlook.body: Onboarded Kalyan Jewellers and Chemmanur; serving 300+ independent jewellers; IIBX Jeweller onboarding in progress
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: International expansion via Sharjah hub (GCC access); pan-India rollout (North, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka); B2C e-commerce platform launch; CNC-machined jewellery as high-margin new category; potential export growth via UAE free zone
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: AJC is a Kerala-based, vertically integrated B2B gold jewellery manufacturer with a proprietary digital platform serving top retail chains and 300+ independent jewellers, now expanding into high-margin D2C silver retail and international manufacturing via Sharjah to capture formalization tailwinds and margin expansion. The IPO-funded capex and design-led differentiation position it to double revenues by FY27.
